Preparing for knee replacement surgery? These five prehab exercises can help build strength, improve mobility, and prepare your body for a smoother recovery. Learn why what you do before surgery can make a difference afterward.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
